bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 87.5K on YouTube. ELITE starts with a priority list.
beats.text: ELITE is your 12-month small-group coaching, and the page says only a few traders will be selected. But the only way in is “Join the priority list”: no application, no call. You can't select anyone before they're already on the list.

beats.title: A book, a podcast, and live at the NYSE.
beats.text: You wrote Five-Year Millionaire, you've been on the Schwab Network, Fox and NBC, and your Masters Membership already sells at $3,999. The people who read the book and watch the channel trust you. ELITE is where the serious ones belong.

stats.label: national TV features on your site

beats.title: Your most personal program has no conversation in front of it.
beats.text: Masters, ELITE, trade alerts, the beginner bundle and the separate courses sit side by side on one pricing page. A visitor has to work out alone which one fits, and ELITE, the one that needs a conversation most, only collects a name for a list.

beats.title: “We already have a Book a call button.” Keep it.
beats.text: This adds the step before the call for ELITE only: one page that sells the 12 months, a seven-question application, and then the call. Everyone else keeps buying the Masters Membership and the courses exactly as they do today.
beats.quote: “I help people go from nervous beginner to confident stocks & options trader.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Think about your goals for the next 12 months, and what you've tried so far.

One note: payments only happen through the official Power Trades University website or from this email address, never through a DM.

Talk soon,
Jason

preCallEmails.subject: Why I never trade with only one outcome in mind
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I've lost money before because I got too attached to being right.

That's why I go into every trade with a plan for both outcomes. If the market confirms my idea, I know what to do. If it doesn't, I know that too.

That's the kind of thinking we build in ELITE, applied to your own goals.

On the call we'll look at where your plan has gaps today.

Jason

preCallEmails.subject: "I'm already in the Masters Membership"
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Good. Then you know the courses and the group calls.

ELITE is for when you want the plan built around you: a small group, direct access to me and the coaches, and twelve months of working on your goals.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Jason

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. What you want your money and your investing to look like in 12 months.
3. How ELITE works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Jason

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your ELITE call
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Jason

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Jason
